title: GeoSync Immutable Dataset Manifest
description: One manifest per canonical committed dataset. Records immutable provenance (source, retrieval, license, checksum) plus the evidence class the dataset may back. The dataset-level checksum is the sha256 of the sorted per-file 'path  sha256' digest lines (see scripts/ci/check_dataset_manifests.py::dataset_digest). Task DAT-001.

id.description: Stable, unique dataset id. A result citing this dataset references this id plus the checksum below.

vendor.description: Who produced the raw bytes. 'neuron7xLab-generator' for synthetic; a named vendor/exchange for empirical data.

origin.description: Provenance class of the bytes. 'repository_generated' == synthetic and thus SIMULATION-eligible.

uri.description: Retrieval endpoint / vendor URI, or null when generated in-repo.

retrieval_method.description: How the bytes were obtained (generator command, REST endpoint, vendor export, ...).

retrieval_time.description: UTC ISO-8601 retrieval timestamp for empirical data, or the literal 'SYNTHETIC_GENERATED' for repository-generated datasets.

query.description: The exact selection/query/generation invocation that produced the dataset.

license.description: License / redistribution status. An SPDX id (e.g. 'MIT') for cleared data. Empty, 'UNKNOWN', 'UNLICENSED', 'NONE', 'TBD', or 'PUBLIC_NO_LICENSE' are NOT cleared and cause the gate to fail closed (RED).

license_verified.description: Set true only by an independent license audit (SEC-015). The manifest RECORDS the license; SEC-015 VERIFIES it. Absent/false == not yet independently verified.

value.description: Dataset-level digest: sha256 over the sorted 'path  <file-sha256>' lines of files[] (dataset_digest()).

bytes.description: Total on-disk size of all files[] in bytes.

revision_status.description: FROZEN datasets must never change bytes without a new id.

access_restrictions.description: Redistribution / usage restrictions, or 'none' when unrestricted.

evidence_class.description: The evidence class this dataset may back. Repository-generated == SIMULATION. Real market/vendor data == MEASURED (and MUST NOT be laundered as SIMULATION).

path.description: Repo-root-relative POSIX path to the dataset file.

flags.description: Governance flags. REAL_DATA_CONTRADICTS_SYNTHETIC_ONLY_BOUNDARY marks empirical data that violates the NO_DEPLOY / synthetic-only project boundary.
